boy_000.text: I use the internet almost every day — look, my laptop!

boy_001.text: Good question! And is everything we do online always safe?

girl_002.text: Let’s find out — together. Come on, explorer!

boy_003.text: Whoa — the whole internet is waiting for us!

girl_004.text: Yes! But remember our question — is it ALWAYS good? Let’s keep our eyes open.

boy_005.text: So my question actually zoomed all the way to a server and back?!

girl_006.text: Exactly. Little packets of data carried it — faster than you can blink.

boy_007.text: The internet is basically a super-fast messenger. Cool!

boy_008.text: Whoa! Look at all the things we can do on the internet!

girl_009.text: And we can CREATE and play too — not just watch. Tap every building and try it!

boy_010.text: We can learn and CREATE almost anything here. This is amazing!

girl_011.text: It really is. But… if the internet is this powerful, could some parts be risky too?

boy_012.text: Hmm. Let’s keep exploring and find out.

girl_013.text: Here come different internet habits. Some are great… some, not so good.

boy_014.text: Easy! Drag each one into GOOD CHOICE or NOT SO GOOD. Let’s sort them!

boy_015.text: That was easier than I thought! Good and not-so-good aren’t so hard to tell apart.

girl_016.text: Sometimes though… the SAME thing can be good OR bad. Like gaming — a little is fun, too much isn’t.

boy_017.text: Ohh. So it’s about balance. Let’s test that next!

girl_018.text: This is the Internet Balance Scale. Benefits on the left, risks on the right.

boy_019.text: So if I add too many risky habits… the scale tips! Let’s try each one.

boy_020.text: So the same activity can be good OR bad — it depends how much!

girl_021.text: Exactly. Too much of anything tips the balance. The trick is moderation.

girl_022.text: Let’s plan a Grade 6 student’s day. Fill each time slot with an activity.

boy_023.text: Too much screen time and our student gets tired. Let’s find a healthy mix!

girl_024.text: Screens are wonderful — with breaks for sleep, play and the people we love.

girl_025.text: Some information is personal. If a stranger gets it, it could be used to hurt us.

boy_026.text: So we lock the private stuff away, and only share what’s safe. Let’s sort them!

boy_027.text: Locked and safe! I’ll never post my address or password online.

girl_028.text: Perfect. Private info is like a house key — keep it to yourself.

boy_029.text: WHOA! A message says I won a FREE PHONE! Let me click it!

girl_030.text: Wait! Did you enter any contest?

girl_032.text: Then why would they send YOU a prize? That’s a classic scam. Let’s learn to spot them.

boy_033.text: Phew! Just because something appears online doesn’t mean I should click it.

girl_034.text: Exactly. Stop, think and check first. Scammers try to make you excited or scared — so slow down.

girl_035.text: Someone you don’t know just started chatting with you online. Let’s see what they want.

boy_036.text: I’ll choose what to do at each step. Help me pick safely!

boy_037.text: That felt uncomfortable — so I ignored, blocked, and would tell my parents.

girl_038.text: That uncomfortable feeling IS the warning. Never share private info, and always tell a trusted adult.

boy_039.text: A website says ‘drinking water after fruit is dangerous.’ Is that… true?

girl_040.text: Let’s not just believe it. In the Truth Lab we CHECK. Who said it? Where’s the evidence?

boy_041.text: So I shouldn’t believe something just because it’s online or looks official.

girl_042.text: Right! Who said it? Is there evidence? Can I check a trusted source? Think before you believe.

boy_043.text: We’ve come so far! Let’s take one big journey through the whole internet world.

girl_044.text: From home, to school, to the world — and into the internet itself. Come on!

girl_045.text: The internet gives us SO many possibilities.

boy_046.text: But we have to decide how we use them — the good stuff, safely.

girl_047.text: Exactly. Now let’s write down OUR rules to remember it all.

girl_048.text: Time to build our rulebook! For each rule, choose the wise ending.

boy_049.text: And every rule we finish becomes a card on the board. Let’s go!

boy_050.text: Our very own rulebook! Seven rules to use the internet smartly.

girl_051.text: And because we built it ourselves, we’ll actually remember it. Ready for the final challenge?

boy_052.text: An arcade! But these games teach real internet skills. First up — building a strong password!

girl_053.text: Let’s forge one so strong no one can guess it. Then we’ll practise being kind online.

boy_054.text: Strong password AND kind words. I feel like a real internet pro now!

girl_055.text: That’s what being Internet Smart means — safe, thoughtful and kind. One challenge left!

girl_056.text: This is it — the Final Challenge! Ten real internet moments, back to back.

boy_057.text: React quickly and wisely. Let’s show what we learned!

girl_058.text: Let’s see your Internet Smart Explorer result and your very own rules!

boy_059.text: A balanced day feels great — energy for everything!

boy_060.text: Too much screen time really does drain your energy. Lesson learned!
